title: He Rejected 1 Million Dollars Right Before His Website Tanked
transcript: This man rejected a once in a lifetime business offer only to have his backup plan fail. He was living a nightmare. We actually had a $1 million offer to purchase Retro Dodo. One of the primary reasons I didn't want to sell, and it goes back to my first project I sold, is the buyer actually destroyed that site, over-optimized, filled it with ads, used AI garbage on it, eradicated off of Google, and I was worried that the purchaser that wanted this brand would do the same. I think we had a couple of weeks to decide whether or not to take it. And then the update happened. We were at around about 200,000 [music] visitors a month now. I was petrified, to be honest with you. People were literally searching for us and couldn't find us anywhere. We're still down about 85% traffic. We were doing everything right. We weren't doing anything shady. We were following Google's guidelines to [music] the T, but it just never ever came back. >> Did you feel like you were gaslit by [music] Google?
